original_sentence: The TGI Fridays drone that injured a Brooklyn Daily photographer; US burger chain Shake Shack having to retreat from plans for entirely cashless ordering sites.
translation: 比如 TGI Fridays 的无人机曾弄伤《布鲁克林日报》摄影师；美国汉堡连锁 Shake Shack 也不得不放弃完全无现金点餐门店的计划。

key_vocabulary.usage_note: retreat from plans 在本句中对应"放弃计划"。
cashless ordering sites 在本句中对应"无现金点餐站点"。
injure a photographer 在本句中对应"弄伤摄影师"。
drone 在本句中对应"无人机"。
